newsitem.title: USA: Highlands in talks to adjust VIK Bros price.
newsitem.headline: Highlands in talks to adjust VIK Bros price.

text.p: Highlands Insurance Group Inc said on Monday it was talking with VIK Brothers Insurance Inc about possibly adjusting the price it would pay to buy the insurer, because of the impact of Hurricane Fran on VIK.
But the company said it could not predict the outcome of the talks yet.

"Highlands is currently conducting due diligence to assess the impact of Hurricane Fran on VIK Brothers Insurance Inc and reviewing its third quarter results," said Richard Haverland, chairman and chief executive officer.
Highlands previously agreed to buy the privately-held VIK for $164 million, including the assumption and repayment of debt and preferred stock.
